details.purpose: To record the TNM staging classification for colorectal cancer (Sixth edition).
details.use: Use for TNM Sixth Edition of colorectal cancer staging
details.misuse: Do not use for editions of TNM classification, other than Sixth edition.

items.items: Carcinoma in situ, invasion of lamina propria.
Tumour invades through muscularis propria into subserosa or into non-peritonealized pericolic or perirectal tissues.
Tumor directly invades other organs or structures.
Metastasis in 1 to 3 regional lymph nodes.
Metastasis in 4 or more regional lymph nodes.
T1 N0 M0, T2 N0 M0
Carcinoma in situ: intraepithelial or invasion of lamina propria.
Tumour invades through muscularis propria into subserosa or into non-peritonealized pericolic or perirectal tissues.
Tumour directly invades other organs or structures and/or perforates visceral peritoneum.
Regional lymph nodes cannot be assessed.
Metastasis in 1 to 3 regional lymph nodes.
Metastasis in 4 or more regional lymph nodes.

Clinical TNM pre-treatment classification based on physical examination, imaging and biopsies.
Clincal assessment of the primary tumour.
